# Tools & Equipment Insurance

> Specialized tools and equipment insurance for contractors — scheduled tools & equipment floaters for nail guns, saws, lasers, generators, and compressors; mobile equipment; installation floaters; equipment breakdown; inland marine; and commercial auto for work trucks and tool trailers. A division of Contractors Choice Agency (founded 2005, licensed all 50 states, NPN 8608479). A-rated carriers, 15-minute quotes, 2-hour claims response.

Tools & Equipment Insurance helps gear-heavy contractors get coverage that actually protects their investment: scheduled tools floaters at replacement cost, mobile equipment at agreed value, installation floaters for materials in transit, and equipment breakdown for internal failures. General liability does NOT cover your tools — we build the inland marine coverage that does. We shop A-rated specialty markets and turn around certificates and schedules fast.

## Coverage lines
- [Tools & Equipment Floater](https://toolandequipmentinsurance.com/services/tools-and-equipment): Scheduled gear — nail guns, saws, lasers, generators, compressors — at replacement cost. The core policy every gear-heavy contractor needs.
- [Scheduled Equipment & Mobile Gear](https://toolandequipmentinsurance.com/services/scheduled-equipment): High-value mobile equipment — lifts, towable compressors, welder generators — scheduled at agreed value.
- [Installation Floater](https://toolandequipmentinsurance.com/services/installation-floater): Materials in transit and until installed — closing the gap between supplier and structure.
- [Inland Marine](https://toolandequipmentinsurance.com/services/inland-marine): Broader coverage for equipment and goods in transit, off-site, and on jobsites.
- [Equipment Breakdown](https://toolandequipmentinsurance.com/services/equipment-breakdown): Internal mechanical and electrical failure (boiler & machinery) — the failures property excludes.
- [Commercial Auto](https://toolandequipmentinsurance.com/services/commercial-auto): Work trucks and tool trailers, including theft-from-vehicle exposure.
- [General Liability](https://toolandequipmentinsurance.com/services/general-liability): Third-party bodily injury & property damage — note: GL does NOT cover your tools.
- [Umbrella / Excess Liability](https://toolandequipmentinsurance.com/services/umbrella-excess-liability): Layered limits to $10M+ above underlying liability policies.
